title: Page 60
transc:
1220 AM 24  Eastport Miss Jany 21st 1865 
Eastport twenty one Gen Halleck ----
your telegraph of the 17th just received ----
strength of twenty third corps about twenty
thousand ---- I do not know the number of
number of companies of Artillery to be supplied
with batteries sig ----
Geo H Thomas
Maj Gen


920 AM  Norfolk Jan 24 1865
Norfolk 24th for Comdr H A Wise Chf
Bu Ord Washn . 12 torpedoes of nine hundred pounds 
each with insulating wire are required by Comdr Parker
Comdg 5th Divn James river for immediate use 
signed D Lynch Comdr & Inspector of Ord


10.35 am  City Point Jany 24th 1865
930 am 24th GV Fox I would like to leave
Ft Monroe tomw eve or next day morning for Fort Fisher
. Can you not go ? I would also be
pleased to go on a naval vessel if it is
convenient to spare one Ocean transportation snow 
all employed carrying troops US Grant

(ahr) for Halleck
. I shall probably left here by 12 M tomorrow for
Fort Fisher . All troops of Schofields command 
may be forwarded directing to that point . Meighers
command will go in the same way in the absence of
further directions . If Schofield reaches Washn in time 
I would like to have him accompany me. US Grant 
Lt Gen
